result.summary: An internal campaign request form initiated by Lynnette Stevens (dated in the Date Initiated field as 21-Jan-00) and addressed to Kelli Scruggs, with CC recipients. It requests a direct mail coupon campaign for Newport Parent, Lights & 120's cigarettes targeting competitive smokers aged 21–34, with approximate circulation of 600,000 across listed states in Tiers II & IV. The coupon value is $1.50 off a pack, with a coupon issue date of 4/14/00 and expiration date of 9/30/00. A 'For Control Use Only' section shows assigned code 05787 and an estimated redemption rate of 13%.
